tagline: Eight miles east toward the marsh country and the Broad River.
intro: From the SC 462 junction at Okatie, near Oldfield, SC 170 runs east as a four-lane road with very little roadside business, for a while following the line between Jasper and Beaufort counties. Past the Callawassie Island turnoff it is in Beaufort County for good, and the country opens out into marshes and islands for miles.

This is the main road between Beaufort and the Bluffton side of the county, and it carries plenty of traffic. Okatie, where it starts, takes its name from the Okatee River, an estuary of Port Royal Sound. The scenic stretch ends at the Broad River Bridge.

moments.title: Chechesee River and Lemon Island
moments.text: The bridge over the Chechesee River passes above the Edgar C. Glenn Boat Ramp, and the road winds on southeast across Lemon Island.

moments.title: Broad River Bridge
moments.text: A 1.7-mile, four-lane bridge from 2004 replaced the old two-lane drawbridge, and what is left of the drawbridge now serves as a fishing pier on the north side.
